q.linePrev: Keep fallacies off your lips, see casualties in the wind
q.lineNext: Galaxy's the distance between us by Christmas

partner.line: Now we crumblin', leaf over tree pre-twist (I bet)

q.songTitle: You Don’t Care for Me Enough to Cry
stanza: I dreamt I'd take you with me
And you'd say you forgive me
And we'd live out some easy ancient song
You lost the mind to even do me wrong
